concerns.text: FR-003 references “see FR‑016” for the aggregation rule justification, but FR‑016 concerns separation of topology and performance data, not aggregation methodology. The cross‑reference is incorrect.
US2 cites “(See SC-007)”, yet SC-007 defines the power‑analysis success criterion, which is unrelated to graph construction and metric computation. This cross‑reference appears erroneous.
